purpose: Diagnostic cause audit of the 93 extraction-primary held candidates; not a runtime selection rule, allowlist, or answer evaluation.

method.ids: Exact candidateId join from the existing all-115 source audit; only records with primary causeDomain=extraction are included.
method.sourceEvidence: Reuses exact emitter token spans and the existing exact row/cell/header spans. Unresolved source navigation remains explicitly unresolved; candidate metadata is not used to invent a source row.
method.subtypePolicy: Exactly one primary subtype per ID. OCR/layout issues are listed as overlapping contributors and do not change the extraction-primary cohort count.
method.replacementPolicy: Any source-native result is a separate extraction run/set. Preserve the original wrong or duplicate candidate claim as historical evidence. Source-native parsing should operate over all rows and cells, never this ID list.
method.repairLanguage: Potential indicates a source-structure opportunity only; no replacement extractor was run and no fix is claimed. OCR-glyph, segmentation, or header-geometry conflicts remain unresolved until a source-native parser handles them without manual correction.

subtypes.definition: Candidate uses a wrong or generic header/measure/predicate, or selects the wrong period cell. Source-native header-to-cell projection may address this where the OCR table grid is sound.
A multi-cell row sequence is emitted as one candidate value.
Candidate misroutes subject, entity name, ordinal, index, or field role.
Candidate value/subject token is not exact in its emitting chunk. Chunk-local selection alone cannot ground it.
Several candidate records repeat the same source row/cell claim.
